title: Linux commit 5f256bec — [NET]: Basic network namespace infrastructure.

claims_extracted.claim: The basic infrastructure commit introduces struct net, per-network-namespace initialization and exit registration, namespace reference/lifetime machinery, and a global namespace list.
claims_extracted.notes: This is a core-substrate anchor, not evidence that every protocol family was already namespace-safe.

notes: Exact Torvalds-tree anchor for 03/16. Do not equate this commit alone with complete operational network namespaces.
